_comment: Agent standards registry for OrchestKit: one row per standard on each agent boundary, what we run today, where we are going, and the gate that holds it. Ported from hq-ext-plugin configs/standards.json (#1983 + #1990), scoped to this repo. The frontmatter block below is the single source of the src/**/SKILL.md and src/agents/*.md key allowlists read by scripts/check-frontmatter.py.

level_scale.1: a home-grown or proprietary equivalent exists
level_scale.4: adopted plus a conformance test or gate

standards.note: 107 SKILL.md under src/skills plus 7 under src/codex/ork-codex/skills. The advisory gate judges them against spec keys UNION the Claude Code skill keys in the frontmatter block; the ratchet baseline carries the existing house keys (tags, version, author, complexity, triggers, persuasion-type, ...) so only NEW non-spec keys report.

standards.spec_version_seen: CC CHANGELOG copy of 2.1.283 (read by hq-ext 2026-09-27)
standards.note: 36 agents under src/agents. Each agent claude_code_keys entry carries the CC CHANGELOG version that shows Claude Code reads it. Ork house keys (category, taskTypes, keywords, examplePrompts, critical_system_reminder, required_mcp_servers) belong under metadata and are baselined at top level.

frontmatter._comment: Allowlists for scripts/check-frontmatter.py. Allowed top-level keys = base_keys UNION claude_code_keys. For SKILL.md base_keys is the Agent Skills spec key set; src/agents/*.md are not Agent Skills files, so their base is name, description and metadata. House-only keys belong under metadata (a one-level string map). Every Claude Code key carries the CC CHANGELOG version that shows Claude Code reads it (copy of CC 2.1.283, read 2026-09-27 by hq-ext). house_keys beyond the hq-ext nine are the ork vocabulary observed in this tree (agent, persuasion-type, targets, path_patterns, invocation_hooks, tool-coverage, upstream-version-tested, critical_system_reminder, required_mcp_servers).
